title: The Dark Path
caption: The Dark Path (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During battle, if you just drew a destiny, may lose that card to cancel and redraw that destiny. When you draw battle destiny, may lose X Force (limit 3) to make attrition against opponent +X.
lore: “If once you start down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. Consume you it will, as it did Obi-Wan’s apprentice.”

notes: Non-unique (no dot; wiki: Unrestricted). Text transcribed as this Remaster sheet prints it; the sheet's cover notes errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007 (the stub's game_text_note says the same) — this transcription is the sheet's (post-errata) text; the pre-errata wording is not on this sheet. The slip's bottom strip prints a small gold/bronze sphere between the caption and the number (an errata marker, presumably) — not transcribed as an icon. Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes “…” and curly apostrophe (wiki straight single quotes); 'Obi-Wan’s' is one hyphenated word broken at the line end on the printed card (wiki has 'Obi- Wan's' with a stray space) — confirmed on the 745 px V10 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible on it. Modern: V10-D-thedarkpath.gif (745 px, the Virtual Set 10 remake); VB2 -pre (350) and a VB9 combo image (begin landing your troops & the dark path) also exist, not downloaded.
